body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to half your Movement in addition to your normal movement this turn.

surges.html: On a success, the target suffers -1 Defense against your next Ballistics Action this turn.
This Action may trace its shot around one intervening obstacle that does not completely enclose the target.

rider.title: TARGETING
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you, you may trace your next Ballistics Action against it this turn from your current position even if you move before then.
